# Golden console lines for the calibration routine (src/CalRoutineFlow.h,
# CalRoutineLines). test_calroutine_flow.cpp checks the firmware formatter
# produces each of these byte for byte, that the flow logs exactly these
# CALR# header lines at the start of a run, and that every CALR line of a
# simulated run has its header's field count. The host-side parser reads the
# same file. Change one side and the other fails.
#
# Shape: CALR,<SUB>,<field>,... -- comma-separated, no spaces around commas,
# fixed decimals, outputs and inputs 1-based (0 = none), masks in upper-case
# hex (bit n = output/input n+1; rail_mask bit k = table entry k). The
# CALR# lines name each SUB's fields in order.
CALR#,version=2
CALR#,METER,identity
CALR#,STATE,ms,stage,out,in
CALR#,OUT,out
CALR#,NODE,out,k,target_mv,code,measured_mv,iters,rail
CALR#,REREAD,out,target_mv,code,spread_mv
CALR#,SWEEP,out,target_mv,code,measured_mv,resid_mv,counted
CALR#,ORES,out,result,reason,worst_mv,worst_at_mv,rail_mask
CALR#,IN,in,src_out,lo_mv,hi_mv
CALR#,IPT,in,mv,code,mean_raw,pp_raw,samples,used
CALR#,IRES,in,result,verdict,gain_uv,offset_mv,holdout_mv,line_dev_mv,points
CALR#,RETRY,scpi,attempt
CALR#,MERR,step,reply
CALR#,LOST,out
CALR#,BACK,out
CALR#,REDO,out
CALR#,RESULT,can_save,out_pass,in_pass
CALR#,SAVE,result
CALR#,DISCARD
CALR#,CANCEL,stage
CALR#,FAIL,reason
CALR#,MODE,mode
CALR#,WARN,reason
CALR#,PATCH,out,moved,own_delta_raw
CALR#,PRES,result,crossed,missing
CALR,METER,Siglent Technologies;SDM3065X;SDM36GBX000000;1.01.01.25
CALR,STATE,123456,CAL_OUT,4,0
CALR,OUT,3
CALR,NODE,3,7,8400,45873,8400.094,3,0
CALR,REREAD,1,3600,19661,0.734
CALR,SWEEP,5,7440,40630,7440.472,0.472,1
CALR,ORES,6,PASS,OK,0.413,10560,400
CALR,IN,1,1,600,10800
CALR,IPT,7,600,3277,3889.37,2.25,3333,1
CALR,IRES,4,PASS,OK,-2930.5,12000.41,1.23,4.57,19
CALR,RETRY,READ?,2
CALR,MERR,SETUP,-113;"Undefined header"
CALR,LOST,4
CALR,BACK,4
CALR,REDO,3
CALR,RESULT,1,FF,F7
CALR,SAVE,OK
CALR,DISCARD
CALR,CANCEL,SWEEP_OUT
CALR,FAIL,METER_TIMEOUT
CALR,MODE,SELF
CALR,WARN,NO_MARKER
CALR,PATCH,3,10,3.25
CALR,PRES,FAIL,14,08
